items.text:
Hey you, the one with a full-time job!  Don't get this game.

I respect what Ostranauts is [i]trying[/i] to do.  But even 9 hours in and I still feel like I'm doing a chore rather than playing a game.  Whereas similar games (such as Project Zomboid) make it a point to allow the player to learn and make mistakes, this game is unforgiving in an irritating way.  Obfuscate this with mechanics that don't seem to do anything (such as the entire "mood" system) and you have a game that's a headache to learn at best.

On top of that, there's several game-breaking bugs and unfinished AI that [i]do[/i] make the early-mid game hard to even get to.  The devs also seem intent on "finishing" the game before fixing existing systems (another contrast to PZ).  I've seen this many times before, and I'm not going to hold my breath when the release is a mess.

I [i]do[/i] think a game like this is great for those with several weeks worth of time on their hands, but even then, you'd likely have better returns just going to the park or something.

6/10, [i]way[/i] too much time investment for too little reward.
items.text_zh:
嘿，你，那个有全职工作的人！别买这个游戏。

我尊重Ostranauts[i]试图[/i]做的事情。但即使玩了9个小时，我仍然觉得自己在做家务而不是在玩游戏。类似游戏（比如《僵尸毁灭工程》）特意让玩家学习和犯错，而这个游戏却以一种令人恼火的方式毫不宽容。再用那些似乎毫无作用的机制（比如整个“情绪”系统）来混淆视听，你得到的是一款最多只能说是让人头疼的学习游戏。

除此之外，还有几个破坏游戏的bug和未完成的AI，[i]确实[/i]让前中期游戏都难以进行。开发者似乎还打算在修复现有系统之前就“完成”游戏（与PZ的另一个对比）。我以前见过很多次这种情况，当发布一团糟时，我不会屏息以待。

我[i]确实[/i]认为这样的游戏适合那些有几周空闲时间的人，但即便如此，你可能去公园或做点别的会得到更好的回报。

6/10，[i]太[/i]多的时间投入换来的回报太少。
